Cookie Policy

Last updated: 11 October 2026

This website uses a few essential cookies to work. It uses one analytics cookie, and only if you accept it. The desktop app is covered by our Privacy Policy.

What cookies are

Cookies are small text files a website stores in your browser. Websites can also keep data in your browser's local storage and session storage. This policy covers all three, and we call them cookies here.

Essential cookies are needed for the site to work and don't need your consent. Every other cookie needs your consent first. That's the rule under the EU ePrivacy Directive and the Swedish Electronic Communications Act (lagen om elektronisk kommunikation, chapter 9, section 28).

Analytics (only if you accept)

NameSet byPurposeKept for
session-idLovable's analyticsGroups the pages you view in one visit, so we can count visits rather than page loads.30 minutes

If you accept, Lovable's analytics and Lovable's page events also receive the page address, the referring page, your browser type, language and screen performance, a rough location taken from your time zone, and campaign tags in the link you followed (such as utm_source). These requests go to timewarpdev.com and Lovable processes them for us. If you reject, or haven't chosen yet, none of this is stored or sent.

We don't use advertising cookies or social media pixels, and we don't sell or share data for advertising.

Change your choice

You can change your choice at any time. Withdrawing consent doesn't affect anything collected before you withdrew it. When you reject analytics, we delete the analytics cookie.

If your browser sends a Global Privacy Control signal, we treat it as a rejection and don't show the banner. You can still opt in under Cookie settings. You can also delete cookies or block them in your browser's settings. If you block essential cookies, parts of the site may not work.

Downloads

The Mac download comes from GitHub and the Windows download from the Microsoft Store. When you download, those services handle your request under their own privacy and cookie policies.

More information

Our Privacy Policy explains how we handle personal data, who processes it for us and your rights. Questions: support@timewarpdev.com.
